knowledge_gaps: The negative sampler is underspecified: sampling 64 negatives and then masking does not guarantee 64 valid unique negatives. Define resampling, small-catalog fallback, and whether the objective is uncorrected candidate cross-entropy or sampling-corrected softmax.

The diagnostic loader supplies no user IDs. Excluding each user's complete training history requires an explicit training-sampler interface or precomputed exclusion mapping; it cannot be inferred reliably from truncated sequences.

The residual lacks reproducible details: embedding scaling, projection and gate dimensions, initialization, normalization, dropout, and padding behavior. A five-item mean may reinforce substitutes or already satisfied needs; retaining SASRec does not guarantee preservation of enduring preferences.

No baseline validation scores, measured training costs, checkpoint schedule, or concrete allocation of the 43,200 GPU-second budget are provided. Four configurations across four categories may exceed the budget. Repeated selection on 200 users per category also risks validation overfitting.

Originality 4/10 is plausible for established components, but potential 8/10 and difficulty 4/10 remain subjective estimates. Training margins do not establish the proposed mechanism; raw margins depend on score scale, and mean embedding cosine alone cannot rule out representation collapse.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the loss definition and implement a feasible sampler without silently changing candidate counts or assuming unavailable user IDs.
